method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly).
overview: Watershed is an enterprise sustainability software company: companies such as Airbnb, FedEx and Visa use it to measure emissions, manage climate and ESG data and produce audit-ready reports (including CSRD), with in-house climate experts and a decarbonization marketplace.

differentiators.text: Combines a carbon-data engine with in-house climate experts to turn operations and supply-chain data into audit-ready climate and ESG reporting.
differentiators.significance: Directly relevant to your CDP/EcoVadis and ESG-reporting experience, from the software side.

flexibility.text: Postings describe a hybrid setup with offices in San Francisco, New York and London, plus remote staff in the US and Europe.
flexibility.significance: NYC office exists; arrangements vary by role.

culture.text: Describes itself as a mission-oriented startup looking for people who want to work hard; values: customer-obsessed, outcome-oriented, inclusive.
